structure.note: Three classes (per the FY2025 10-K): Class A subordinate voting shares with one vote per share, Class B restricted voting shares with 10 votes per share (convertible into Class A one-for-one) and one Founder Share held by Tobias Lütke. The Founder Share carries a variable number of votes that brings Lütke, his immediate family and affiliates to at least 40% of total voting power, capped at 49.9%. At April 21, 2026 he held 40.02% of the votes, below a majority.

geography.basis: Total external revenues by geographic location, based on the location of the Company's merchants

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Financial figures are from the original FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001594805-26-000007, filed February 11, 2026), reporting in US dollars. Shopify files no DEF 14A; its security ownership disclosure is Item 12 of the Form 10-K/A Amendment No. 1 (accession 0001594805-26-000011, filed April 29, 2026), which adds Part III only and does not restate the financial statements, as at April 21, 2026. LEADER: Tobias Lütke is CEO. The filing states class percentages (0.13% of Class A, 99.59% of Class B, the one Founder Share) and 40.02% of aggregate voting power, but no percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the 6.11% is in leader.derived. It counts shares owned, controlled or directed: 1,290,000 Class A and 66,130,362 Class B held by 7910240 Canada Inc. and 258,000 Class A held by Thistledown Foundation, which Lütke is deemed to own, plus 11,619,770 Class B held directly. The beneficial-ownership table, which also counts 786,822 Class A shares from options and RSUs (exercisable or vesting within 60 days), shows him with 2,334,822 Class A shares (less than 1% of Class A); on that SEC basis (option and RSU shares added to numerator and denominator) the derived figure would be 6.16% rather than 6.11%. HOLDERS: the filing says Lütke is the only person or entity known to own more than 5% of any class, so largestHolders is empty. CASH: no dividends have ever been paid; the FY2025 financing section shows only option-exercise proceeds and the $1,043 million maturity of convertible notes, and Item 5 reports no issuer purchases of equity securities, so buybacks are 0. The board authorized a repurchase program of up to $2 billion of Class A shares in February 2026, after the fiscal year. STOCK COMP: the cash-flow add-back equals the XBRL-tagged stock-based compensation expense ($449 million).

ecosystem.notes: GMV includes shipping, duties and VAT, and is net of refunds. Shopify's revenue includes subscription fees as well as payment processing fees. Shopify Payments carried $248.1B of the GMV in 2025 (65.6% penetration). The FY2025 original 10-K was used, not the 10-K/A filed 2026-04-29 (Part III only). No ecosystem study was used.

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (original FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001594805-26-000007). Interest income (0.331bn) is received inside operating cash flow but is not revenue, so it lowers paidOut by about 3.5%. Loan purchases and originations (Shopify Capital) sit in investing activities, not operating cash flow.

marketcap.notes: Class A trades on Nasdaq and the TSX under the same symbol, SHOP; the Nasdaq line (USD, the reporting currency; the TSX line is SHOP.TO in CAD) is used. Both are direct listings of the same shares, not ADRs. The FY2025 10-K says 'Our Class B restricted voting shares and Founder share are not listed for trading or quoted on any exchange or market.' The single Founder Share, which carries variable votes and, per the 10-K/A, 'represents a de minimis percentage of the total issued and outstanding shares', is left out.

pay.notes: Employees: year-end count from the FY2025 10-K. Payroll is null: the 10-K gives no total of salaries, benefits or other personnel costs (it describes personnel-related costs only as components of cost of revenues and operating expenses, and gives year-over-year changes in 'employee-related costs'), and Shopify, a foreign private issuer, files no proxy, so its 10-K/A Part III has no CEO pay ratio and no median employee pay.
